title: feat(spec,rest,client): the email surface joins getRoute(), and the scoped client derives its prefix from discovery (#6714)
body:
Fixes #6714

Replicates the #6633 / PR #6712 four-lane pattern for the email surface, per the maintainer ruling archived in [comment 5226487193](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/6714#issuecomment-5226487193). Face 2 was **measured and deliberately left alone**, as the ruling required.

## The premise, measured (not asserted)

Booting `RestServer` with `api.apiPath = '/backend/api/v9'` and recording the mount table:

| | measured |
|---|---|
| email mounts | `POST /backend/api/v9/email/send` — **the only one** |
| the pre-#6714 client's URL | `POST /api/v1/email/send` → **not in the table** |
| scoped mounts | 83 routes, all under `/backend/api/v9/environments/:environmentId/…` |
| the pre-#6714 `scope()` prefix | `/api/v1/environments/…` → **zero mounts** |

So face 1 is a **live 404 today** on any `apiPath` deployment, not a latent gap — which is why this card outranked the other two faces. Face 3 is the same defect across every scoped `meta` / `data` / `batch` / `packages` / `automation` URL.

## The four lanes

- **spec** (`minor`, purely additive) — `ApiRoutesSchema` declares `email`: the base under which `POST {email}/send` is mounted. `optional`, exactly like `datasources`: absent = not mounted.
- **rest** (`minor`) — `/discovery` advertises `routes.email` as a **projection of the recorded mount** (`getMountedEmailRouteBase()` reads the RouteManager row `registerEmailEndpoints` wrote), never recomputed. Mount moves ⇒ advertisement moves by construction. Not mounted ⇒ not advertised.
- **client** (`patch`) — `email.send` goes through `getRoute('email')`; `ScopedProjectClient.scope()` derives its prefix from the advertised `routes.data` base.
- **parity pin** — `discovery-advertised-direct-mounts.parity.test.ts` extended: the advertised base + `/send` must resolve in the **same** mounted table, across default-base, non-default-base, `apiPath`, no-package-service and scoped boots.

**No `serviceToRouteKey` entry** — established, not assumed: `email` is not a `CoreServiceName` slot at all, the mount belongs to the REST host that builder cannot see, and `registerEmailEndpoints` mounts *unconditionally* (501-degrading), so service-presence isn't even the mount predicate. The absence is now pinned in `discovery-schema-conformance.test.ts`, same disposition as `datasources` / `mcp`.

## Why `routes.data` and not the `scoping` block (face 3)

Measured: the advertised `scoping` block carries `enabled` / `resolution` / `scoped` / `environmentId` — **posture only, no path**. It cannot yield a base. `routes.data` is advertised as `{realBase}{crud.dataPrefix}`, so it is the one derivable source. When `dataPrefix` is customised away from `/data` the derivation **declines** and the convention holds — no lenient re-parsing.

Review of that derivation caught a real edge and fixed it: rest advertises `scoping.environmentId` as `req.params?.environmentId`, so a host that never populated the param answers `scoped: true` with no id. The first cut then returned a base that was *still scoped*, and `scope()` would have built a doubled `…/environments/:environmentId/environments/<id>/meta` — **strictly worse** than the hardcode. Now: strip the advertised id when it matches, else strip one trailing `/environments/{segment}` on the strength of `scoped` alone, else **decline**. Both branches pinned.

## Face 2 — measured, and deliberately NOT converged

The ruling said measure before deciding, and the measurement says leave it:

- `@objectstack/rest` mounts **zero** `/cloud/*` routes. Not a grep result: `rest-route-ledger.ts` is exhaustive over what rest mounts (two-way conformance gate — a mounted route with no row fails, a row nothing mounts fails), and it has **0** cloud entries.
- The runtime dispatcher has **no cloud domain** — no `handleCloud`, no `domains/cloud.ts`; it explicitly excludes `/cloud` as another host's control plane (`skipPaths`, the `/cloud/environments/` resolver guard, "strategy lives in the cloud distribution"). The doc block listing cloud routes is an orphaned relic with no method behind it.
- `apiPath` is a **`@objectstack/rest`-only** config knob (declared in its `ApiConfig`, read only by `getApiBasePath()`).

⇒ the cloud control plane does not follow `apiPath`, so converging it onto `getRoute()` would invent a coupling that does not exist. Left untouched. (The `objectstack-ai/cloud` repo is not reachable from this session, so its own mount base is unmeasured — noted honestly; it cannot be moved by this repo's `apiPath` either way.)

The maintainer's **rejected** alternative — deriving everything from one known base instead of per-face keys — is precisely what the parity pin's per-face assertions prevent.

## Byte-identical fallback (#6712's A/B/C model)

Reverting **both** client halves to the pre-#6714 hardcodes turns exactly **3** tests red — all of them case C (follow-the-advertisement). **161 stay green**, including every case-A pin (unconnected ⇒ `/api/v1/email/send`, `/api/v1/environments/…`) and case B (connected without the key / underivable base). That is the proof that A and B assert today's bytes and only the new capability is new.

## Reverse verification (predictions written before running)

| # | prediction | measured |
|---|---|---|
| P1.1 | remove the spec key ⇒ spec schema test red | ✅ red |
| P1.1b | …and the client typecheck red (`Record<ApiRouteType,…>` is total) | ⚠️ **did not materialise** — the client typechecks against spec's *built dist*, so totality binds only after a rebuild. Verified the guard is real from the other side: dropping the client's convention row while the key is declared ⇒ `TS2741 Property 'email' is missing`. |
| — | *(unpredicted)* rebuilding spec after a key removal | 🔎 **blocked by the authorable-surface ratchet**, which demands a tombstone — a guard I had not anticipated |
| P2.3 | delete the rest projection ⇒ parity pin red | ✅ red, all 5 cases |
| P2.4 | recompute from `realBase` instead of projecting ⇒ pin still passes | ✅ **passes — reported as a limitation.** The pin guards the mount/advertise *split*, not the projection technique; they only differ once the two disagree, which is what drift is. A *convention* recompute does go red (2 cases). |
| P2.2 / P3.4 | revert client halves ⇒ only case C red | ✅ exactly 3 red, 161 green |
| P4.1 | `check:authorable-surface` red before regen | ✅ red, naming exactly `api/ApiRoutes:email` |
| P4.2 | `email` row reaches the generated reference page | ✅ one row in `discovery.mdx` |

## Generated artifacts

Rebuilt **from the merged source**, never text-merged (AGENTS.md §11 — the trap #6712's dev hit). Delta is exactly one line in each: `api/ApiRoutes:email` in `authorable-surface/api.json`, one table row in `content/docs/references/api/discovery.mdx`. Both gates re-verified green after each of the **three** `origin/main` merges this branch absorbed.

## Gates

`pnpm lint` ✅ · `turbo run typecheck` **125/125** ✅ · full build closure **70/70** ✅ · spec **347 files** ✅ · rest **71/71** ✅ · client **21 files / 278 tests** ✅ · all 52 `check:*` gates ✅ including `check:type-check-debt`, `check:i18n-coverage`, `check:authorable-surface`, `check:docs`.

Two caveats, both verified not mine:
- One full-rest-suite run showed 2 unrelated files red (`analytics-read-scope-refusal-envelope`, `rest-exec-ctx-principal-kind`). Both pass in isolation and the full suite has since run green **3×** with the change in — an order/parallelism flake, not a regression.
- `check:objectui-pin-fresh` is red — reproduced red on the shared `main` checkout too. Pre-existing release-hygiene debt (#3340), untouched here.

Stayed clear of #6535's contended `IMPORT_JOB_MAX_ROWS` region in `rest-server.ts`; this edit lives in the discovery-advertisement region.
